description: `--coverage` with Jest 30.5.2's defaults (T8.10, B23b): no `collectCoverageFrom`, so only the files the tests loaded are reported (`src/unused.ts` is not), the babel provider, the reporters `json`, `text`, `lcov` and `clover` into `<rootDir>/coverage` (`coverage.reportsDirectory`). Recorded as Jest wrote it, clover's timestamps and Istanbul's per-file `hash` (a digest that holds the work directory's path) masked. Read by `provino`'s `jest-coverage.test.ts`.
